newsitem.title: JAPAN: Thailand has not set topic for Friday meeting - MOF.
newsitem.headline: Thailand has not set topic for Friday meeting - MOF.

text.p: Thailand has not told Japan's Finance Ministry of any specific issues it wants to discuss in Friday's meeting between Japan's Finance Minister and his Thai counterpart, Japanese Vice Finance Minister Takeshi Komura told reporters on Thursday.

"They will meet tomorrow but there has not been any word on whether they want to discuss a specific issue. The talks are aimed at introductions and explaining the recent situation in Thailand," Komura said.
Komura added that Thai Finance Minister Thanong Bidaya had already said he was not seeking aid in this visit to Japan.
Thanong, along with Bank of Thailand Governor Rerngchai Marakanond, arrived in Tokyo on Wednesday for a visit until Friday.
Asked about the rise in Japan's customs-cleared trade surplus for June, Komura said that it could be explained by special factors arising from the increase in the nation's sales tax.
Japan's contentious trade surplus rose for the third successive month in June, jumping 27.7 percent from a year earlier to 934.21 billion yen, the Finance Ministry said earlier.
